versions.description: Timed boost events that fill your server at the times you choose. Schedule them with cron expressions in the config (default: Friday 20:00-22:00 UTC) or start one by hand with `happyhour start <minutes> [multiplier]`. While an event runs, players earn bonus currency on kills (base x (multiplier - 1)) and on playtime, can get extra item drops on kills, and the server gets start, reminder and end broadcasts. Players type `happyhour` to see the status and time left. Optional Discord announcements. The module pays its own bonus and never changes other modules' settings.

commands.name: happyhour
commands.description: Show happy hour status; admins can start or stop it.
commands.helpText: happyhour = status and time left. Admins: happyhour start <minutes> [multiplier], happyhour stop.

arguments.name: multiplier
arguments.helpText: Boost, e.g. 2 for double (start only, default from config)

hooks.name: on-kill
hooks.description: During happy hour: pay the kill bonus and roll the bonus drop.

cronJobs.name: tick
cronJobs.description: Every minute: start scheduled happy hours, send heads-ups and reminders, pay the playtime bonus, end expired events.

functions.name: hh-helpers

permissions.description: Start and stop happy hour with the happyhour command.
Count = extra percent on this player's happy hour bonus currency (50 = +50%).
